text: {"lessons":["I have often sold stocks after modest gains, so I will avoid letting the satisfaction of a realized profit override the stock’s prospects and the value of staying invested.","My purchases have sometimes followed earlier sales, and I have added to Stock A and Stock D at different prices; I will assess each new buy on its current risk and expected return, not on past trades or cost basis.","Even with a professional background, frequent account checks can encourage unnecessary trading; I will make decisions for the whole portfolio and keep enough diversification and cash flexibility for changing conditions."]}
